notes: Formal deity-offer record wave for the post-Kyne scale-out. Use with tools/pdv-phase20-race-author --author-rewards / --check-rewards. This spec intentionally covers message records and manager VMAD properties only; source eligibility lives in the live PDV__ManagerQuest.psc.

messageRecords.title: Azura's Twilight
messageRecords.body: You have lived toward me without naming it -- the thresholds kept, the hard truths faced. This is not leaving the ancestors. It is the ash-prayer deepening toward dawn. Will you name me your focus?

messageRecords.title: Boethiah's Trial
messageRecords.body: You have proven yourself against the unworthy again and again. The ancestors witnessed it; now I ask for it by name. This deepens the Reclamation; it does not replace the ash. Will you name me your focus?

messageRecords.title: Mephala's Whisper
messageRecords.body: You have kept the web whole without being asked. The hidden people are safer for you. Name me your focus, and the ash-prayer deepens into the web -- nothing of the ancestors is set down. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Accept
messageRecords.body: The ash-prayer has a name now. The Reclamation deepens in you, and the ancestors are not set down.

messageRecords.title: Not Yet
messageRecords.body: Not yet. The ash-prayer holds as it was, and the threshold stays open to you.

messageRecords.title: Refuse
messageRecords.body: You keep to the shared Reclamations. The deepening is set aside, and will not be offered again soon.

messageRecords.title: Auri-El's Path
messageRecords.body: You have kept the dawn through every temptation to forget it. Make the return your focus, and the foundation becomes the whole of your faith. Will you name me?

messageRecords.title: Magnus and the Elder Way
messageRecords.body: You study as escape, not as utility. That is my path. Name me your focus, and the arts become the road back. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Xarxes and the Record
messageRecords.body: You trust what is written over what is enforced. Name me your focus, and the lineage and the quiet truth become your devotion. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Accept
messageRecords.body: You name this focus. The foundation narrows to a single disciplined road, and the dawn holds in you.

messageRecords.title: Not Yet
messageRecords.body: Not yet. The foundation stands as it was, and the path waits for you.

messageRecords.title: Refuse
messageRecords.body: You keep to the foundation alone. The focus is set aside, and the offer will not soon return.

messageRecords.title: Akatosh's Order
messageRecords.body: Your devotion has not wavered through upheaval. Carry the god of time as your own, and the long order becomes your faith. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Talos Calls the Defier
messageRecords.body: You kept faith with me where the law forbade it. Carry the old breath openly, and the Empire's own god answers a treason of conscience. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Kynareth's Road
messageRecords.body: The open way has been kind to you. Carry Kynareth as your own, and the road and the sky answer. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Mara's House
messageRecords.body: You have built and mended where you could. Carry the mother of the people as your own, and the civic heart is yours to keep. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Zenithar's Trade
messageRecords.body: Your work is honest and your weight is true. Carry the trade-god as your own, and the day's labor becomes worship. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Arkay's Covenant
messageRecords.body: You have kept the rites the war neglected. Carry Arkay as your own, and the death-cycle is your charge. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Stendarr's Mercy
messageRecords.body: You have stayed the killing hand where the province wanted it loosed. Carry Stendarr as your own. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Julianos' Code
messageRecords.body: You study, you weigh, you judge with care. Carry Julianos as your own, and the written truth is your devotion. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Dibella's Grace
messageRecords.body: You make beauty and speak well where it matters most. Carry Dibella as your own. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Accept
messageRecords.body: You take this patron. The broad faith narrows to one, and the order keeps you as its own.

messageRecords.title: Not Yet
messageRecords.body: Not yet. Broad worship holds, and the patron waits on your word.

messageRecords.title: Refuse
messageRecords.body: You keep to broad worship. The patronage is declined, and will not be offered again soon.

messageRecords.title: Tu'whacca's Charge
messageRecords.body: You tend the dead and turn back the undead. Carry Tu'whacca as your own, and the guidance of souls to the Far Shores is your charge. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Leki's Blade
messageRecords.body: Your sword-work is disciplined and honest. Carry Leki as your own, and the blade becomes devotion made exact. Will you?

messageRecords.title: HoonDing's Call
messageRecords.body: Again and again you have made a way where there was none. Carry the Make-Way God as your own, and the impossible passage becomes your devotion. Will you?

messageRecords.title: Accept
messageRecords.body: You walk under this god now. The sect's broad worship narrows to one charge, carried as your own.

messageRecords.title: Not Yet
messageRecords.body: Not yet. The sect's worship holds as it was, and the charge waits for you.

messageRecords.title: Refuse
messageRecords.body: You keep to the sect's broad worship. The charge is set aside, and will not soon be offered again.
